title: EventBus idempotent duplicate callback registration contract

contract.idempotent_registration: Registering the same plugin, event and callback repeatedly does not create duplicate listener entries
contract.registration_result: Repeated registration of an already registered callback returns true
contract.single_delivery: An idempotently registered callback receives each emitted event only once
contract.unregister: An existing callback can be removed successfully
contract.repeated_unregister: Unregistering an already removed callback returns false
contract.registry_cleanup: The listener registry is empty after successful removal
contract.future_delivery_absence: Removed callbacks do not receive subsequent events
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after registration and removal
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus callback operations require the events permission
